taken as written

clue.text: Unsophisticated arts graduates in charge

clue.text: Beautiful woman has got hold of a gun? It's just a game

explanation.definitionFit: To start again is to make a fresh beginning, as a noun a second start.

parts.note: moments are times
taken as written

explanation.surface: Fleeting memories are linked by a single musical step.
explanation.definitionFit: A semitone is a half step, the smallest interval in Western scales.

clue.text: English royal got involved in fairground entertainment

indicators.note: the letters of these three words are tangled into a new order

clue.text: Trader handling money on the doorstep who must keep a float

parts.note: a float sounds like a supply of change, but it is the electric vehicle a doorstep dairy deliverer drives

explanation.surface: A doorstep salesman needs a stock of loose change.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain milk was delivered daily from a slow electric van called a milk float.
explanation.definitionFit: A milk delivery man sells bottles at householders' doors and drives a milk float.

clue.text: Leader of organisation, fat and pompous

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

clue.text: Alien male destroyed in battle

indicators.note: the two words are wrecked and rebuilt in a different order

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
an urge is a desire

explanation.surface: Rolling waves inspire a wish to stow away on a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to billow is to swell and roll like waves, which is to surge.

clue.text: In short, this American state is all right

definitions.text: In short, this American state is all right

explanation.definitionFit: The state's short form matches the expression for acceptable, so it is the state that is all right in brief.

clue.text: Abridge legal document

clue.text: Can odd lessons involve the head? Yes

clue.text: One of those spotted in a Disney film?

clue.text: Take to the air in frenzied dances

clue.text: Regional language dictionary includes a word for "beer"
